en: Dependent on a non-indicative phenomenon, a non-indicative phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-indicative phenomenon, a non-non-indicative phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-indicative phenomenon, both non-non-indicative and non-indicative phenomena arise by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause condition, three; in the case of object condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, three. (Full details for all cases.)
